disputes.description: Worked 10 verified masonry shifts for Suresh Builders on Pier 42 (₹9,000 statutory contract wage). Disbursed only ₹7,200. Underpaid by ₹1,800.

Misclassification of semi-skilled tile layer as unskilled helper.
Unlawful deductions for drinking water and safety helmets.
